annotations.title: Cartons per layer and per pallet (Ti × Hi)

description: Cartons per layer (Ti), layers per pallet (Hi) and cartons per pallet for one carton size, the load height and the total weight. Ti is the best of an all-one-way pattern, an all-turned pattern and two two-block mixes; the carton height stays vertical. All lengths are in unit (in or cm). Choose pallet from list_equipment ids (default 48x40) or give palletLength and palletWidth. overhang is how far the load may hang past each pallet edge (default 0). Give maxHeight (total load height, pallet included) with deckHeight (the empty pallet height) for Hi; without them only Ti is returned. Neither is assumed: the page offers sourced starting values. Give cartonWeight (and palletWeight) for the total weight. Capacity ratings for a 48 × 40 pallet appear only as a warning.

cartonWeight.description: Weight of one carton, in weightUnit

deckHeight.description: Height of the empty pallet, in unit. Required with maxHeight

height.description: Carton height, in unit. This side stays vertical

maxHeight.description: Greatest total load height, pallet included, in unit. Give with deckHeight

overhang.description: Overhang allowed past each pallet edge, in unit

pallet.description: Pallet id. Ignored when palletLength and palletWidth are given

palletLength.description: Custom pallet length, in unit. Give with palletWidth

palletWeight.description: Weight of the empty pallet, in weightUnit

palletWidth.description: Custom pallet width, in unit. Give with palletLength
